narrative.overview: UniGrade reads like a concise academic record. A stable dark rail and pale work surface frame the student's grade target; numbered rows and thin rules make courses easy to scan. Thai Prompt carries explanations and actions, while DM Mono distinguishes quantities, codes, and GPA figures.
keyCharacteristics: The goal is the strongest visual panel; course and deadline information follows in indexed rows.
Flat, lightly ruled surfaces keep a dense workspace legible.
Teal marks actions and active location; warm color marks deadlines and attention.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve warm color for attention and status; ordinary progress and navigation use teal.

rules.name: The Measured Number Rule
rules.body: Use DM Mono for comparable figures and indexes, then return to Prompt for Thai names and explanatory copy.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Prefer a border or divider over a raised card when grouping academic information.

dos: Do lead planning views with the target GPA and the remaining requirement.
Do use thin rules, numbered rows, and tabular figures for comparable academic data.
Do preserve Thai readability and the visible gold keyboard focus treatment.
donts: Don't turn every panel into a floating or glass surface.
Don't use warm attention colors for ordinary navigation.
Don't hide the primary planning action behind secondary statistics.
